formula: For mean mu, parent Var=mu+a0*mu^2 with signed a0 (no positive floor), keep rho<=.8. Y=Binomial(X,rho)+NB((1-rho)*mu,a_add), a_add=(a_target-rho^2*a0)/(1-rho)^2. Adapt rho downward if needed so a_add>=0. Then VarY=mu+a_target*mu^2 under working depth-conditioned moments, for ANY parent dispersion. This is a moment model, not an inferred biological turnover rate or guaranteed marginal distribution after projection.
